notes:
Summary: regional transmission operator (controls for substations and SCADA ops) evaluating Redwood Private for on-prem inference. They require fully air-gapped deployment: no outbound connections, signed binaries only, kernel lockdown, and vetted physical media updates.

Key quotes and shorthand from discovery: 
- CTO: "We cannot permit outbound model pulls; updates move on USB with chain-of-custody log."
- Security lead: "Need FIPS KMS or HSM integration; HSM must be FIPS 140-2 validated."

POC ask: 6-week air-gapped evaluation in a regional control center (RHEL 8.6), run 2 workloads: (1) incident summarization & chat agent for on-call operators (short prompts, strict hallucination budgets), (2) policy/regulatory document search and extraction across >1.2M pages (embeddings + reranking). Acceptance criteria: offline model update procedure validated, audit log retention 7 years, latency SLOs met for control-room operator queries (<150ms per token average for short-chat flows), deterministic model versioning and rollback.

Risks noted: NERC CIP checkpointing; vendor must support physical media model delivery and detailed SBOM. Procurement has concerns about ITAR and cross-border model provenance. Security wants end-to-end attestation and ability to run in FIPS mode.
